name: The Mills Overrun
summary: In Tirisfal, the Scourge gather at Agamand Mills, close to Forsaken settlements. Deathguard Dillinger sends soldiers from Brill to break their ranks before the ruined mills become a base for attacks deeper into the glades.

sections.title: A Looming Threat on the Mills
sections.body: The Agamand Mills once anchored Tirisfal Glades' agriculture. Since the Third War, their windmills overlook Scourge forces massing on the grounds under the Lich King's thrall. These mindless undead threaten the fledgling Forsaken holdings. If they secure the mills, they will have a base from which to push deeper into Tirisfal and strike at those settlements.

sections.title: Proof of Destruction
sections.body: Deathguard Dillinger, who helps fortify Brill and patrols the territory, sends recruits against the Scourge. They hunt Rattlecage and Cracked Skull Soldiers, along with Darkeye Bonecasters. Dillinger asks for notched ribs and blackened skulls as proof that the skeletal ranks have been broken apart and driven back toward the Plaguelands before their offensive begins.

faq.q: Why are the Scourge gathering at Agamand Mills?
faq.answer: The Scourge gather to establish a staging ground in western Tirisfal. From Agamand Mills, they can launch raids deeper into the glades and threaten nearby Forsaken settlements such as Brill.
Deathguard Dillinger is a Forsaken sentry stationed in Brill. He coordinates strikes against dangers in Tirisfal Glades, including the Scourge and hostile gnoll packs threatening the road.

faq.q: Where are the Agamand Mills located?
aliases: how to get to the mills
faq.answer: Agamand Mills lies north of the main western highway in Tirisfal Glades. From Brill, cross the river bridge to the west and follow the north fork to the ruined windmills.

faq.q: Why does Dillinger want ribs and skulls?
faq.answer: Dillinger asks for ribs and skulls as proof that the Scourge front line has been broken. The notched ribs come from skeletal infantry, and the blackened skulls from bonecasters.

faq.q: What is the relationship between the Forsaken and the Scourge here?
faq.answer: The Forsaken are undead who broke free of the Lich King's mental domination. The Scourge remain mindless slaves to his will, seeking to wipe out the Forsaken and reclaim Lordaeron for their master.

faq.q: What happens after clearing these Scourge?
faq.answer: Clearing the foot soldiers is only an opening blow against the Scourge at Agamand Mills. Dillinger and the Deathguards keep pushing deeper into the mills against the commanders and dark forces entrenched there.

angles.text: For you as Forsaken, driving the Scourge from Agamand Mills protects your new lands and strikes at the mindless slaves of the Lich King who once held you in thrall.
For you in the Horde, holding Tirisfal Glades helps secure the Horde's only foothold in northern Lordaeron. Destroying Scourge staging grounds is a tactical priority.
As a warrior, you face armored skeletons at Agamand Mills, relentless foes who feel no pain and give no quarter.
